status: candidate source and cleanup/layout trial; may proceed to separate current-court trial only; not accepted or registered

cleanup.method: Separate 11 RGBA figures by connected alpha>=32 components; crop each component; nearest-neighbor resize uniformly to max64x80; place in row-major 80x96 cells at baseline88. Preserve original colors and alpha. No recoloring or outline edits.
cleanup.layoutRationale: The first per-pose 80x96 cleanup was preserved as rejected because fitting wide arm-extension poses independently caused a visible character-size reduction. The selected layout uses 128x112 cells and one shared scale so all frames keep consistent body height while retaining >=8px gutters and baseline alignment.

candidateReview.status: PASS for isolated cleanup and current-court track-trial preparation only; not approved for packing or runtime
candidateReview.notes: All 11 poses are full-body, unique and in the intended sequence. Pose5 reads as a forward two-hand shove at sheet scale but the two palms/forearms overlap in the side-facing view; verify that both hands remain legible at native game scale. It is distinct from anticipation pose4 and follow-through pose6. Character identity, pointed ear, auburn hair, copper amulet, skin tone, and burgundy/copper uniform remain coherent with the accepted Kraken idle/block references. The final cell is transparent. The selected 128x112 shared-scale cleanup keeps all anatomy in bounds and has 8px margins on every side. Hands are empty and no basketball is drawn. Art has a little more blended shading than the sharpest accepted Kraken block pixels; identity is coherent, but independent visual review and gameplay trial are still required. The separate athlete-specific ball track is unvalidated for this new atlas.
